digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI/workflow scheduling and concurrency management
propositions: Gerrit Verified dispatch-triggered workflow, not tickets-branch pushes, dominates GitHub Actions runner queue during peak periods
Current per-run job count ranges from 17 (no mutation shards) to 24 (all seven mutation shards selected), with up to 13 jobs runnable simultaneously after classification

Observed incident-period burst reached 22 waiting jobs and 873s maximum runner wait; current-period burst reached 22 waiting with 197s maximum wait, indicating persistent contention at organization Free plan limits

Four mutually exclusive remediation options exist: (A) bundle short preflights and cap mutation parallelism to reduce immediate fan-out from 13 to 10 jobs; (B) coalesce superseded patchsets with debounce; (C) move macOS to branch-health workflow; (D) upgrade organization plan from Free to Team
Option A is recommended as it reduces peak demand (19 → 12 maximum simultaneous) while retaining full pre-merge coverage without recurring cost
No CI behavior changes have been implemented; ticket awaits operator approval before implementation plan and code review
